sentences.en: The Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 隐秘的大脑。

sentences.en: Revealing patterns of the mind.
sentences.zh: 揭示思维的模式。

sentences.en: Please do not be alarmed.
sentences.zh: 请不要惊慌。

sentences.en: The adults in my life know where I am.
sentences.zh: 我生活中的大人们知道我在哪里。

sentences.en: They practice something called free-range parenting.
sentences.zh: 他们实行一种叫做“放养式育儿”的理念。

sentences.en: We've gone out with them.
sentences.zh: 我们曾带他们出去过。

sentences.en: We've taught them how to cross the street.
sentences.zh: 我们教过他们如何过马路。

sentences.en: We've observed them.
sentences.zh: 我们观察过他们。

sentences.en: You know, it's not like we somehow dropped them off in the middle of a jungle and said, fend for yourselves, kid.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这并不是说我们把他们扔在丛林中央，然后说，孩子，自求多福吧。

sentences.en: But the state has now sent the Métives a letter saying what they've done is unsubstantiated child neglect.
sentences.zh: 但现在州政府给梅蒂夫一家发了一封信，称他们的行为属于未经证实的虐待儿童。

sentences.en: The Métives say the county's applying a law that says you can't leave a young child alone in a car or building.
sentences.zh: 梅蒂夫夫妇表示，县政府正在应用一条法律，规定不能将幼儿单独留在车内或建筑物内。

sentences.en: To them, that law can be stretched to be out anywhere, playgrounds, walking home from school.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，这条法律可以被无限延伸到任何地方，比如在外面玩耍、独自从学校走回家。

sentences.en: And to us, that's apples and oranges.
sentences.zh: 而在我们看来，这完全是两码事。

sentences.en: What I'm doing messing up my kid?
sentences.zh: 我所做的一切是在毁掉我的孩子吗？

sentences.en: That's the question many parents ask, and it's the subject of today's Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这是许多父母都会问的问题，也是今天《隐秘的大脑》的主题。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantham, and I too am a parent.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆，我也是一位家长。

sentences.en: The news clips we heard from WUSA 9 and DC's Fox 5 local news are of the Métive family in Silver Spring, Maryland.
sentences.zh: 我们刚才听到的来自 WUSA 9 和华盛顿特区 Fox 5 本地新闻的片段，报道的是马里兰州银泉市的梅蒂夫一家。

sentences.en: Daniel and Alexander Métive allow their 10-year-old son and 6-year-old daughter to walk one mile home from a park without adult supervision.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔和亚历山大·梅蒂夫允许他们 10 岁的儿子和 6 岁的女儿在没有成人监护的情况下，独自从公园走一英里回家。

sentences.en: They believe in free-range parenting, and that's pretty much the opposite of helicopter parenting.
sentences.zh: 他们信奉放养式育儿，这与“直升机式育儿”恰恰相反。

sentences.en: The idea is you teach your children to be independent instead of providing closed supervision at all times.
sentences.zh: 其理念是教导孩子独立，而不是时刻进行严密监控。

sentences.en: Parents in both camps will tell you they are simply doing their best to make good decisions for their children every day.
sentences.zh: 两个阵营的父母都会告诉你，他们只是在尽最大努力为孩子每天做出正确的决定。

sentences.en: But sometimes, the decisions that parents make for children can have unintentionally negative consequences.
sentences.zh: 但有时，父母为孩子做出的决定可能会产生意想不到的负面后果。

sentences.en: NPR science correspondent John Hamilton recently had a story about one such parent making one such choice.
sentences.zh: NPR 科学记者约翰·汉密尔顿最近报道了一个关于某位家长做出此类选择的故事。

sentences.en: I asked him to join me in the studio to talk about the story of a Tennessee mother named Juniper Russo.
sentences.zh: 我邀请他来到演播室，和我一起聊聊田纳西州一位名叫朱尼珀·鲁索的母亲的故事。

sentences.en: John, thanks for joining me.
sentences.zh: 约翰，谢谢你加入我。

sentences.en: Pleasure to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能来这里。

sentences.en: You did this wonderful story recently for Morning Edition about this Tennessee mother.
sentences.zh: 你最近为《早间版》节目制作了一篇关于这位田纳西州母亲的精彩报道。

sentences.en: Can you tell me about her?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我讲讲她吗？

sentences.en: Well, I was interested in somebody whose views on something had changed.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我对那些在某些问题上观点发生过改变的人很感兴趣。

sentences.en: So this is a woman who, when she started out, she got pregnant and she wanted to do everything just perfect for her unborn child.
sentences.zh: 这是一个女人，她刚怀孕时，想为未出生的孩子做一切完美的事情。

sentences.en: And so she was organic and natural.
sentences.zh: 所以她追求有机和自然。

sentences.en: She describes herself as a crunchy mom.
sentences.zh: 她形容自己是一位“崇尚自然”的妈妈。

sentences.en: So she was doing all the things that crunchy moms do to try to take care of themselves and ensure the best for their kids.
sentences.zh: 她做了所有崇尚自然的妈妈会做的事，试图照顾好自己，并确保给孩子最好的。

sentences.en: And she genuinely had the best interests of her child at heart as she was doing these things.
sentences.zh: 而且她在做这些事时，确实是真心为孩子着想。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: And when her child was born,
sentences.zh: 当她的孩子出生时，

sentences.en: one of the decisions she made was she didn't think she wanted to get her child vaccinated because she was concerned that vaccines might do some kind of harm to her child.
sentences.zh: 她做出的决定之一是，她认为不想让孩子接种疫苗，因为她担心疫苗可能会对孩子造成某种伤害。

sentences.en: Is it because they were sort of an unnatural kind of thing?
sentences.zh: 是因为它们属于某种不自然的东西吗？

sentences.en: They were putting in toxic and foreign substances into your body?
sentences.zh: 它们会把有毒和外来的物质注入你的身体？

sentences.en: Was that her concern?
sentences.zh: 那是她的担忧吗？

sentences.en: Part of it was a fear that she described of toxic substances, bad things happening because of vaccine.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是她所描述的对有毒物质的恐惧，担心疫苗会导致不好的事情发生。

sentences.en: But there was something else, too.
sentences.zh: 但还有别的原因。

sentences.en: And I have a little piece of tape here where she explains her point of view.
sentences.zh: 我这里有一小段录音，她解释了自己的观点。

sentences.en: I wanted to live in the kind of world where it was safe to, you know,
sentences.zh: 我想生活在这样一个世界里，在那里，你知道，

sentences.en: always have babies naturally and where you could expect your children to survive to adulthood without necessarily needing modern medicine.
sentences.zh: 总是能自然地生下宝宝，而且你可以期待你的孩子无需现代医学也能平安长大。

sentences.en: So you can kind of hear that she wants to believe she's raising her child in a kind of utopian world.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以听出来，她想相信自己是在一个乌托邦式的世界里抚养孩子。

sentences.en: And again, this is wishing the beSt.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，这是在祈求最好的结果。

sentences.en: And so what I find really interesting here is, of course, this is not a parent who is callous about their child.
sentences.zh: 我发现这里真正有趣的是，当然，这并不是一位对孩子冷漠的家长。

sentences.en: This is not a parent who is neglectful.
sentences.zh: 这也不是一位疏于照顾的家长。

sentences.en: If anything, it's the opposite.
sentences.zh: 如果说有什么不同的话，那恰恰相反。

sentences.en: It's a parent who is deeply involved and wants the best thing for their child and makes this decision that runs contrary to what public health officials tell us all the time.
sentences.zh: 这是一位深度参与并希望给孩子最好的，却做出了与公共卫生官员一直告诉我们的建议背道而驰的决定的家长。

sentences.en: What public health officials say.
sentences.zh: 公共卫生官员所说的。

sentences.en: But, of course, she's hearing from a group of people who are very concerned about a possible link between vaccination and autism.
sentences.zh: 但当然，她从一群非常担心疫苗接种与自闭症之间可能存在联系的人那里听到了声音。

sentences.en: And she is terribly afraid that her daughter might grow up to have autism.
sentences.zh: 她非常害怕女儿长大后会患上自闭症。

sentences.en: So she decided eventually to get her child vaccinated?
sentences.zh: 所以她最终决定让孩子接种疫苗了？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And a number of things happened.
sentences.zh: 后来发生了一些事情。

sentences.en: She began to read the literature and question a little bit some of the echo chambers she was in.
sentences.zh: 她开始阅读相关文献，并对自己所处的某些信息茧房产生了一些质疑。

sentences.en: But the other thing that happened was as her daughter began to get a little bit older, she started not to meet certain developmental milestones.
sentences.zh: 但另一件事是，随着女儿开始长大一点，她发现孩子没有达到某些发育里程碑。

sentences.en: Now, she hadn't gotten vaccinated up to this point.
sentences.zh: 当时她还没有接种疫苗？

sentences.en: No, she had not been vaccinated up to this point.
sentences.zh: 不，在那之前她还没有接种过疫苗。

sentences.en: And so what Juniper knew was that there was no way vaccines could be causing any sort of probleMs.
sentences.zh: 所以朱尼珀当时知道，疫苗根本不可能导致任何问题。

sentences.en: And it was interesting how she talked about when she first learned what was going on.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，她谈到了自己最初得知情况时的反应。

sentences.en: Here's a little piece of tape where she talks about it.
sentences.zh: 这是一段她谈论此事的录音。

sentences.en: I had like this immediate crisis when the doctor told me that she had developmental delays because I thought I had done everything absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 当医生告诉我她有发育迟缓时，我立刻陷入了危机，因为我以为我所做的一切绝对都是正确的。

sentences.en: And developmental delays are for those parents who, you know, do everything wrong.
sentences.zh: 而发育迟缓，那是针对那些你知道的，做错了一切的父母的。

sentences.en: And so, of course, the irony here is that she's trying her best to protect her child and she's doing something that's in the child's best intereSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，这里的讽刺之处在于，她竭尽全力保护孩子，做着她认为对孩子最有利的事情。

sentences.en: And it turns out not to be the case.
sentences.zh: 结果却并非如此。

sentences.en: Not at all.
sentences.zh: 一点也不。

sentences.en: And eventually her child did go on to get a diagnosis of autism.
sentences.zh: 最终她的孩子确实被诊断出患有自闭症。

sentences.en: Now, along the way, she began having the greatest thing she feared was a child with autism.
sentences.zh: 在此过程中，她开始经历她最恐惧的事情，那就是拥有一个患有自闭症的孩子。

sentences.en: And now she has one.
sentences.zh: 而现在她确实有了一个。

sentences.en: She began to rethink two things.
sentences.zh: 她开始重新思考两件事。

sentences.en: One was her thoughts about autism.
sentences.zh: 一是她对自闭症的看法。

sentences.en: It wasn't the terrible thing she had imagined might be.
sentences.zh: 它并不是她想象中那种可怕的东西。

sentences.en: It wasn't the worst thing ever.
sentences.zh: 它不是世界上最糟糕的事情。

sentences.en: She also began to think, oh, this is not necessarily the thing that happens if you're the wrong kind of parent.
sentences.zh: 她也开始认为，哦，这并不一定是因为你是一个不称职的父母才会发生的事情。

sentences.en: And so she started to get her child vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 于是她开始让孩子接种疫苗。

sentences.en: And eventually she got all caught up.
sentences.zh: 最终她补齐了所有疫苗。

sentences.en: So I'm fascinated by this, John, because I want to explore this larger world of how parents are constantly making choices for their children.
sentences.zh: 约翰，我对此很着迷，因为我想探索这个更广阔的世界，看看父母是如何不断地为孩子做出选择的。

sentences.en: Now, some parents, of course, are abusive and neglectful.
sentences.zh: 当然，有些父母确实存在虐待和忽视行为。

sentences.en: But the vast majority of parents actually want to communicate the best things to their children.
sentences.zh: 但绝大多数父母实际上都希望把最好的东西传达给孩子。

sentences.en: They're trying to communicate ethical behavior.
sentences.zh: 他们试图传达道德行为。

sentences.en: And they're trying to communicate how to be a good citizen and how to study hard.
sentences.zh: 他们试图传达如何成为一名好公民以及如何努力学习。

sentences.en: And they're trying to do all these things.
sentences.zh: 他们试图做所有这些事情。

sentences.en: But sometimes the things that parents are doing can have unintended or counterproductive effects.
sentences.zh: 但有时父母所做的事情可能会产生意想不到或适得其反的效果。

sentences.en: I think that's what happens most of the time when something bad happens.
sentences.zh: 我认为大多数坏事发生时都是这样。

sentences.en: I mean, I think it's pretty hard to find a parent who is not trying to do the best thing for their child.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为很难找到一个不是在尽力为孩子做最好事情的父母。

sentences.en: But depending on their information and depending on how they go about doing something, it may not turn out that way.
sentences.zh: 但根据他们掌握的信息以及他们做事的方式，结果可能并非如此。

sentences.en: John, thanks so much for talking with me.
sentences.zh: 约翰，非常感谢你与我交谈。

sentences.en: Delighted to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能来这里。

sentences.en: That was NPR science correspondent John Hamilton.
sentences.zh: 以上是 NPR 科学记者约翰·汉密尔顿。

sentences.en: This is The Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这是《隐秘的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆。

sentences.en: We all want our children to grow up to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 我们都希望孩子长大后诚实。

sentences.en: We communicate this to our kids in all kinds of ways.
sentences.zh: 我们通过各种方式向孩子们传达这一点。

sentences.en: So parents seem to model honest behavior to their children.
sentences.zh: 所以父母似乎是在向孩子展示诚实的行为。

sentences.en: That's researcher Anya Samek.
sentences.zh: 那是研究员安雅·萨梅克。

sentences.en: And she finds that parents want to do the right thing.
sentences.zh: 她发现父母确实想做正确的事。

sentences.en: But there's a catch.
sentences.zh: 但有一个陷阱。

sentences.en: They tend to do that more for their daughters than for their sons.
sentences.zh: 他们对女儿往往比对儿子做得更多。

sentences.en: So you're saying that parents are more honest in front of their children.
sentences.zh: 所以你是说父母在孩子面前表现得更诚实。

sentences.en: But you're saying that this actually might not actually be driven by both sets of children or both sons and daughters.
sentences.zh: 但你是说这实际上可能并不是由两类孩子，即儿子和女儿共同驱动的。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So it's driven by girls.
sentences.zh: 所以这是由女孩驱动的。

sentences.en: Let's back up a minute and tell you how Samek came to this conclusion.
sentences.zh: 让我们退后一步，告诉你萨梅克是如何得出这个结论的。

sentences.en: In her study, Samek wanted to see how parents behave with and without their children around.
sentences.zh: 在她的研究中，萨梅克想观察父母在有孩子和没有孩子在场时的行为。

sentences.en: In her laboratory, she had parents play a game.
sentences.zh: 在她的实验室里，她让父母玩了一个游戏。

sentences.en: So in this game, you flip two coins in private.
sentences.zh: 在这个游戏中，你私下抛两枚硬币。

sentences.en: And in this case, because we did this with children as well, we had coins that had a blue side and a green side.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，因为我们也让孩子参与了，所以我们使用的硬币有一面是蓝色，一面是绿色。

sentences.en: And so you have these two coins.
sentences.zh: 所以你有这两枚硬币。

sentences.en: If both land on green, then you're going to get a prize.
sentences.zh: 如果两枚都朝上绿色，那么你就会得到一个奖品。

sentences.en: Now here's the thing.
sentences.zh: 现在关键在于。

sentences.en: The parents were free to report any outcome they wanted.
sentences.zh: 父母可以自由报告他们想要的任何结果。

sentences.en: You definitely can't act dishonest because nobody is in the room observing you.
sentences.zh: 你绝对可以表现得不诚实，因为房间里没有人观察你。

sentences.en: Samek didn't watch the parents play the game, but she relied on statistics to prove whether the parents were cheating.
sentences.zh: 萨梅克没有观看父母玩游戏，但她依靠统计数据来证明父母是否在作弊。

sentences.en: We actually find that people cheat a lot.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上发现人们作弊很多。

sentences.en: So we expect 25% of the time people will win.
sentences.zh: 所以我们预期人们有 25% 的几率获胜。

sentences.en: They actually win 40% of the time.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上有 40% 的几率获胜。

sentences.en: Parents were put in situations where they could win money for themselves or win a toy for their child.
sentences.zh: 父母被置于可以为自己赢得金钱或为孩子赢得玩具的情境中。

sentences.en: Samek tested the parents with their children in and out of the room.
sentences.zh: 萨梅克测试了父母在孩子在场和不在场时的表现。

sentences.en: And here's where she discovered something interesting.
sentences.zh: 在这里她发现了一些有趣的事情。

sentences.en: When parents were with their daughters, they were scrupulously honeSt.
sentences.zh: 当父母和女儿在一起时，他们表现得极其诚实。

sentences.en: When they were with their sons, not so much.
sentences.zh: 当他们和儿子在一起时，就没那么诚实了。

sentences.en: And that's interesting because what we observe in the world is that men tend to be more dishonest than women in these games with adults,
sentences.zh: 这很有趣，因为我们在世界上观察到的是，在这些与成年人玩的游戏中，男性往往比女性更不诚实，

sentences.en: but also in various empirical evidence that's been collected.
sentences.zh: 而且在收集到的各种实证证据中也是如此。

sentences.en: And so one thing that could be happening here is that we see a correlation.
sentences.zh: 所以这里可能发生的一件事是，我们看到了某种相关性。

sentences.en: Parents, knowing that they want to transmit honest behavior to their daughters, do that,
sentences.zh: 父母知道他们想把诚实的行为传达给女儿，所以他们就这么做了，

sentences.en: and then daughters grow up to be more honeSt.
sentences.zh: 然后女儿长大后就变得更诚实了。

sentences.en: Or parents see that it's more socially acceptable for men to be dishonest than women
sentences.zh: 或者父母认为男性比女性不诚实更具社会可接受性，

sentences.en: and then transmit honest behavior to their daughters.
sentences.zh: 然后把诚实的行为传达给了女儿。

sentences.en: What's the implication of this work?
sentences.zh: 这项工作的意义是什么？

sentences.en: I mean, when you look at parents and the behavior of parents,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当你观察父母以及父母的行为时，

sentences.en: and you look at the behavior of parents with their children and with their sons and daughters,
sentences.zh: 当你观察父母与孩子、与儿子和女儿在一起时的行为时，

sentences.en: are there, I mean, besides just being interesting,
sentences.zh: 除了有趣之外，

sentences.en: is there anything that people can say, you know,
sentences.zh: 人们能说，你知道，

sentences.en: this is something that's actionable that I can take and do something with?
sentences.zh: 这是某种可操作的、我可以拿来做点什么的事情吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Well, I think for a long time we thought that perhaps we had honest people in the world
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为很长一段时间以来，我们认为世界上也许有诚实的人，

sentences.en: and we had dishonest people in the world.
sentences.zh: 也有不诚实的人。

sentences.en: But what we see now is that context actually really matters.
sentences.zh: 但我们现在看到的是，环境实际上真的很重要。

sentences.en: And we also see that if we believe the correlation goes the way that we had speculated,
sentences.zh: 我们也看到，如果我们相信相关性的走向正如我们所推测的那样，

sentences.en: we see that parents' modeling behavior actually does seem to affect children.
sentences.zh: 我们看到父母的示范行为确实似乎影响了孩子。

sentences.en: And we do observe parents that are modeling this behavior.
sentences.zh: 而且我们确实观察到父母在示范这种行为。

sentences.en: So if anything, you should make sure you act honestly in front of your kids.
